limitations: QB is the previous game’s dominant passer, not a verified announced starter. This blocks live betting readiness.
QB and passing support remain partly confounded; ridge priors determine how shared signal is allocated. No separate receiver or offensive-line causal values are claimed.
Rushing is a team unit association; defense combines pass/run prevention. Special teams uses net possession-perspective EPA per game.
Supporting-cast ranks use a fixed 60/40 pass/run blend, defense, and special-teams EPA divided by 65. These are research definitions, not optimized thresholds.
Archived odds are not timestamp-aligned with Wednesday ratings. Returns are hypothetical one-unit stakes at archived prices, not executable historical results.

EPA source vintages are retrospective. Nine primary checks cover three priors × (MAE improvement and two market-error groups); ROI intervals are descriptive, and prior project searches are not covered.
